item.title: Fort Bend County Precinct 4 Commissioner Race: Dr. Ramesh Cherivirala Announces Republican Primary Candidacy
item.description: Ramesh Kumar Cherivirala, PhD, a longtime Fort Bend County conservative and financial professional, has announced his candidacy for Precinct 4 commissioner in the Republican primary.

item.title: Astros sell Sugar Land Space Cowboys
item.description: The Houston Astros have agreed to sell three of its Minor League Baseball affiliates to Diamond Baseball Holdings, the team announced Dec. 9.

item.title: Brett's BBQ Shop Closing: Popular Katy Restaurant to Shut Down After 7 Years
item.description: CITY OF KATY, Texas (Covering Katy News) — Brett's BBQ Shop, a popular barbecue restaurant in Katy, will permanently close its doors after seven years in business, the owners announced on Tuesday.

item.title: Katy approves $4.46 million contract for Nelson Way bridge and road extension

item.title: Katy City Council Member Dan Smith running for Waller County Commissioner against Katy's Brian Cantrell, the Fire Marshal
item.description: Katy City Council Member Dan Smith is running for the Republican nomination for Waller County Pct. 4 Commissioner.

item.title: Katy's Brian Cantrell runs for Waller County Precinct 4 Commissioner against Katy City Council member Dan Smith
item.description: Waller County Fire Marshal Brian Cantrell is running for Precinct 4 Commissioner, setting up a Republican primary contest with Katy City Council member Dan Smith, who is term-limited and cannot seek reelection to the council.

item.title: Fort Bend County to Invest $9.2M in Duhacsek Park Improvements
item.description: Fort Bend County will invest $9.2 million to upgrade a 50-acre park in Sugar Land under an agreement approved by both the Sugar Land City Council and Fort Bend County Commissioners Court last week.

item.title: Beckendorff, Davis declare candidacies for Waller County judge
item.description: Justin Beckendorff will face Brent Davis in the March 3, 2026, Republican primary election for Waller County Judge. The winner of that primary will be unopposed in the general election as the Democratic Party did not field a candidate.

item.title: Former Katy Mayor Pro Tem Durran Dowdle announces 2026 city council campaign
item.description: Former Ward B Council Member and Mayor Pro Tem Durran Dowdle Friday announced his intention to run for the Katy City Council in the May 2026 municipal election.
